|ingredients = {{Name|Pumpkin|1}}{{Name|Milk|1}} |edibility = 80 }} '''Pumpkin Soup''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. One Pumpkin Soup can be purchased each year from [[Traveling Cart|Traveling Merchant]]'s shop at the [[Festival of Ice]] for {{Price|250}}. It also may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. 5 Pumpkin Soup may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. It is also sold by the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] in the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. One Pumpkin Soup may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |love=Sebastian |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Pumpkin Soup is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]]. ==Recipes== Pumpkin Soup is not used in any [[cooking|recipes]]. ==Tailoring== Pumpkin Soup is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].
